ambient_events: The wreck groans as the swell works at it, shedding a rain of rust.
Something large shifts deep in the flooded hold, and the whole hull shivers.
description: A freighter died here decades ago and never fully sank, its rusted flank a cliff of riveted iron you can board at low swell. Deep in the flooded holds, things have made a home.
name: The Wreck
